title: Strict inert comparison of rigidified quotient resolution towers
statement: Fix the saturated monoidal resolution rule induced by one smooth-functorial saturated fan resolution [lem-trf-functorial-fan-desingularization], [lem-trf-log-fan-chart-blowup], [lem-trf-functorial-log-blowup-etale-descent]. Let $X,Y$ be Noetherian regular separated schemes [def-weil-regular-scheme], [pqf-def-locnoeth] with tame generically free actions of finite groups $G,H$. Suppose that the actions are admissible (invariant affine opens cover), have abelian geometric inertia, and preserve $G$-strict, respectively $H$-strict, strict normal crossings boundaries $B_X,B_Y$ outside which they are free [def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary]. Let $\overline B_X\supset B_X$, $\overline B_Y\supset B_Y$ be invariant normal crossings boundaries whose divisorial fs log structures are very tame [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. Resolve each rigidified log quotient by the fixed rule and pull its tower back in fs log schemes to $X$, respectively $Y$. Regard the underlying towers as normalized blowup towers, retaining their ordered ideal centers. If $\lambda:H\to G$ and $\phi:Y\to X$ are equivariant, induce isomorphisms on geometric inertia, and $B_Y=\phi^{-1}B_X$, $\overline B_Y=\phi^{-1}\overline B_X$, then the induced morphism of rigidified log quotients is strict, and the tower on $Y$ is the contracted scheme pullback of the tower on $X$. Contraction deletes precisely the stages with unit center ideal. The scheme pullback equals the strict-transform tower. These canonical comparisons respect identities and composition and apply to localizations, strict localizations, completions, and finite disjoint unions of the indicated schemes.

source.place: VIII Proposition 5.4.2, Corollary 5.4.4 and 5.4.5, printed pp.126--127; normalized-tower interpretation 5.3.10--5.3.11.
